author: Fixture Reporter
content:
Nvidia has announced a recall of one batch of desktop graphics adapters after identifying a cooling-fan manufacturing defect. Affected customers will be offered replacement units through a dedicated support process.

The company says eligibility will be determined by serial number, and the replacement program will begin next week.
headline: Nvidia Announces Recall Of A Desktop Graphics Adapter Batch Over Fan Fault
summary: Nvidia has announced a replacement program for a batch of desktop graphics adapters after identifying a cooling-fan defect.
